resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the Hearthpane screen you are on and point at its controls.

[{\"name\":\"hearthpane.screen_context\",\"description\":\"Describe the Hearthpane screen in front of the user as structured text (Control Center rooms and devices, Music now playing with its play controls and queue, the Settings page and its rows, Calls rooms with their Video call buttons). No pixels or photos. Call it when the user asks what is on their screen or how to do something on it. Results carry target ids for hearthpane.highlight.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"For how-do-I questions: a few words of the setting the user wants, e.g. dark mode. Adds the matching Settings rows from anywhere, with where they are.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.highlight\",\"description\":\"Pulse one control on the Hearthpane screen in front so the user can see it. Use a target id from hearthpane.screen_context, then tell the user what to do with it.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"target\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A target id from hearthpane.screen_context, e.g. settings:immortal.settingsTheme, cc.room.kitchen, music.controls or a room\'s video_call_target.\"},\"hint\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A few words shown beside the control, e.g. Tap the switch.\"}},\"required\":[\"target\"]}}]
